displayIdentity.body: Epaphroditus risks his life and returns after illness. But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need, because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.
